questions.q: Ashoka's account of the Kalinga War and its aftermath is found in which of his inscriptions?
questions.solution:
The Kalinga War (261 BC) and Ashoka's remorse over it are described in the **Thirteenth Major Rock Edict**. The Maski edict is famous for carrying Ashoka's personal name, and the Bhabru edict praises the Buddha's teachings.

**Answer: Thirteenth Major Rock Edict**
questions.shortcut: Kalinga = Rock Edict XIII — 13, the number of the unlucky war.

questions.q: Which Chola ruler sent a famous naval expedition against the Srivijaya empire of South-East Asia?
questions.solution:
**Rajendra I** launched a great naval expedition against Srivijaya (Sumatra–Malaya, c. 1025 CE) to protect trade routes. His father Rajaraja I is remembered for conquering Sri Lanka and the Maldives.

**Answer: Rajendra I**
questions.shortcut: Sea power = Rajendra (the 'Gangaikonda' who also marched to the Ganga).

questions.q: Krishnadevaraya, the greatest ruler of the Vijayanagara Empire, belonged to which dynasty?
questions.solution:
Krishnadevaraya (1509–1529) belonged to the **Tuluva dynasty**; he wrote 'Amuktamalyada' in Telugu. The Sangama dynasty was the first house of Vijayanagara and the Aravidu dynasty followed the Tuluvas.

**Answer: Tuluva dynasty**
questions.shortcut: Dynasty order — Sangama → Saluva → Tuluva → Aravidu.

questions.q: The Poona Pact of 1932, concerning the Depressed Classes, was signed between Mahatma Gandhi and:
questions.solution:
The Poona Pact (September 1932) between **Gandhi and Ambedkar** replaced separate electorates for the Depressed Classes with reserved seats in provincial legislatures. The Gandhi–Irwin Pact (1931) is a different agreement.

**Answer: Dr B.R. Ambedkar**
questions.shortcut: Communal Award → fast unto death → Poona Pact (1932).

questions.q: At which session of the Indian National Congress was the resolution of Poorna Swaraj (complete independence) passed?
questions.solution:
The **Lahore session, December 1929**, with Jawaharlal Nehru as president, passed the Poorna Swaraj resolution; 26 January 1930 was observed as the first Independence Day. Karachi (1931) passed the Fundamental Rights resolution.

**Answer: Lahore session, 1929**
questions.shortcut: Lahore 1929 → Purna Swaraj → 26 January.

questions.q: Who among the following led the Indian National Army and gave it the slogan 'Dilli Chalo'?
questions.solution:
The 'Dilli Chalo' war cry of the INA march is linked to **Subhas Chandra Bose**, who led the Azad Hind Fauj from 1943. Captain Mohan Singh and Rash Behari Bose helped raise the INA earlier.

**Answer: Subhas Chandra Bose**
questions.shortcut: Dilli Chalo = Netaji's INA war cry.

questions.q: Which Article of the Indian Constitution deals with the procedure for amendment of the Constitution?
questions.solution:
**Article 368** lays down the amendment procedure (special majority; ratification by half the states for certain provisions). Articles 356 and 370 deal with President's Rule and the special status of Jammu and Kashmir respectively.

**Answer: Article 368**
questions.shortcut: 368 = the 'whole constitution' amendment article.

questions.q: Fundamental Duties were added to the Constitution on the recommendation of which committee?
questions.solution:
Fundamental Duties (Article 51A, Part IVA) were inserted by the 42nd Amendment, 1976, on the recommendation of the **Swaran Singh Committee**. The 86th Amendment (2002) added the eleventh duty.

**Answer: Swaran Singh Committee**
questions.shortcut: Duties = 42nd Amendment = Swaran Singh.

questions.q: The Rajya Sabha has to return a Money Bill passed by the Lok Sabha to the Lok Sabha within:
questions.solution:
Under Article 109 the Rajya Sabha must return a Money Bill within **14 days**; it can only recommend changes, which the Lok Sabha may accept or reject.

**Answer: 14 days**
questions.shortcut: Money Bill: born in Lok Sabha, a 14-day guest in the Rajya Sabha.

questions.q: The 73rd Constitutional Amendment Act (1992), which gave constitutional status to Panchayats, added which Schedule to the Constitution?
questions.solution:
The **Eleventh Schedule** (29 subjects for Panchayats) came with the 73rd Amendment, along with Part IX. The Twelfth Schedule (18 subjects, municipalities) came with the 74th Amendment, and the Tenth Schedule deals with anti-defection.

**Answer: Eleventh Schedule**
questions.shortcut: 73 → Panchayat → 11th; 74 → Municipality → 12th.

questions.q: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
questions.solution:
The Tropic of Cancer crosses **eight** states: Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram.

**Answer: 8**
questions.shortcut: West to east: G-R-M-C-J-W-T-M.

questions.q: Nathu La, an important pass on the old Silk Route, connects Sikkim with:
questions.solution:
**Nathu La** links Sikkim with Tibet (China) and is one of the designated India–China border-trade passes, with Shipki La and Lipulekh.

**Answer: Tibet (China)**
questions.shortcut: Nathu La–Sikkim; Shipki La–Himachal; Lipulekh–Uttarakhand.

questions.q: Which is the largest ocean of the world, covering about one-third of the Earth's surface?
questions.solution:
The **Pacific Ocean** is the largest and deepest ocean, covering about one-third of the Earth's surface; the Mariana Trench lies in it.

**Answer: Pacific Ocean**
questions.shortcut: Pacific = the 'king of oceans', largest and deepest.

questions.q: The repo rate is the rate at which:
options: the RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks
commercial banks lend surplus funds to the RBI
banks lend unsecured funds to one another overnight
the government borrows from the RBI
questions.solution:
At the repo rate the **RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks** against securities. Banks parking surplus funds with the RBI is the reverse repo, and overnight inter-bank borrowing is the call money rate.

**Answer: the RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks**
questions.shortcut: repo = RBI lends; reverse repo = RBI borrows.

questions.q: Goods and Services Tax (GST), implemented from 1 July 2017, was introduced by which Constitutional Amendment Act?
questions.solution:
GST was introduced by the **101st Constitutional Amendment Act**; 122nd was the number of the Amendment Bill before enactment — a common trap.

**Answer: 101st Amendment Act**
questions.shortcut: Bill 122 → Act 101.

questions.q: Which instrument is used to measure atmospheric pressure?
questions.solution:
A **barometer** measures atmospheric pressure (mercury or aneroid type). The hygrometer measures humidity, the ammeter electric current and the odometer distance travelled.

**Answer: Barometer**
questions.shortcut: baro = pressure (as in 'bar' of pressure).

questions.q: The escape velocity from the surface of the Earth is approximately:
questions.solution:
Escape velocity from the Earth's surface is about **11.2 km/s**. 7.9 km/s is the near-Earth orbital speed and 9.8 is the value of g in m/s² — watch the units.

**Answer: 11.2 km/s**
questions.shortcut: orbit 7.9 < escape 11.2.

questions.q: 'Dry ice', used for refrigeration, is the solid form of:
questions.solution:
Solid carbon dioxide is called **dry ice** because it turns directly into gas (sublimation) without leaving a wet liquid behind.

**Answer: Carbon dioxide**
questions.shortcut: 'Dry' because it sublimes — solid CO2.

questions.q: The chemical name of quicklime is:
questions.solution:
Quicklime is **calcium oxide** (CaO). Adding water gives slaked lime, calcium hydroxide; calcium carbonate is limestone and calcium sulphate is gypsum (plaster of Paris).

**Answer: Calcium oxide**
questions.shortcut: quicklime + water → slaked lime: CaO → Ca(OH)2.

questions.q: The smallest bone of the human body is:
questions.solution:
The **stapes** in the middle ear is the smallest bone (about 3 mm); the femur is the largest.

**Answer: Stapes**
questions.shortcut: stapes = stirrup — smallest, in the ear.

questions.q: The malarial parasite Plasmodium is transmitted to humans by the bite of:
questions.solution:
Plasmodium reaches humans through the bite of the **female Anopheles mosquito** (only the female feeds on blood). Aedes spreads dengue and Culex spreads filariasis.

**Answer: Female Anopheles mosquito**
questions.shortcut: malaria–Anopheles; dengue–Aedes.

questions.q: Insulin, the hormone that regulates blood sugar, is secreted by:
questions.solution:
Insulin is secreted by the beta cells of the islets of Langerhans in the **pancreas**; its deficiency or resistance causes diabetes.

**Answer: Pancreas**
questions.shortcut: islets of Langerhans = islands in the pancreas.

questions.q: Who is the author of the book 'The Discovery of India'?
questions.solution:
'The Discovery of India' was written by **Jawaharlal Nehru** during his imprisonment at Ahmednagar Fort (1942–46). Gandhi wrote 'My Experiments with Truth'.

**Answer: Jawaharlal Nehru**
questions.shortcut: Nehru: Discovery of India + Glimpses of World History.

questions.q: Which Indian state has the longest coastline?
questions.solution:
**Gujarat** has India's longest coastline (about 1,600 km), followed by Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu.

**Answer: Gujarat**
questions.shortcut: Two gulfs (Kachchh and Khambhat) → longest coast.

questions.q: 'Operation Sindoor', carried out by the Indian Armed Forces in May 2025, was launched in response to which of the following terrorist attacks?
questions.solution:
Operation Sindoor (May 2025) was India's precision-strike response to the **Pahalgam terror attack** of April 2025 in Jammu and Kashmir, in which 26 civilians were killed. Uri (2016) and Pulwama (2019) drew earlier, separate responses.

**Answer: Pahalgam attack, 2025**
questions.shortcut: 2025 attack (Pahalgam) → 2025 operation.
